definitions: A female given name from the Germanic languages.
A town in South Canterbury, New Zealand, named after the FitzGerald family.
Of or pertaining to the medieval FitzGerald dynasty of Ireland.

blocks.text: Geraldine is a feminine form of the first name Gerald. Notable people with the name include:

items: Geraldine Connor (1952–2011), British ethnomusicologist, theatre director, composer and performer
Geraldine L. Daniels (1933–2012), New York politician
Geraldine Ferraro (1935–2011), United States congresswoman and 1984 vice presidential candidate
Geraldina Guerra Garcés, Ecuadorian campaigner against femicide
Geraldine Roman, Filipino journalist and politician
